text:
Maria G: Quick sync — prepping offsite/airlock customer cutover (private). Need clear owners for network egress, package staging, and certs. Proposed flow: canary -> ramp -> full. TL;DR checklist below, ping owners and any blockers.

Logan K: I can take network egress. What exact external endpoints do we need to allow? @Network Team can you confirm IPs and any proxy requirements? :eyes:

Network Team: For this customer we need outbound to container registries + KMS endpoints + metrics exporters. IP ranges (subject to change):
```
10.0.0.0/24  # internal
34.82.120.0/22  # gcr
35.199.64.0/20  # quay
52.58.0.0/16  # kms proxy region-a
```
Also need NTP (pool.ntp.org) and CRL/OCSP to validate certs. We'll provide CIDR exceptions for corporate proxies.

Devon R: FYI I opened infra PR for the airlock bootstrap: repo `infra/airlock` PR #412 — includes systemd unit for the package shard and the canary rollout job. pinging @Jen S for release tagging & review.

ops-bot: Job queued: `infra/airlock/bootstrap` (job id: 8731). Logs will appear in the deploy channel.

Jen S: I'll review PR #412 today, aiming to merge by EOD. Quick ask: include healthcheck header `X-Offsite-Auth: <token>` so the load balancer can detect canary health.

Devon R: Good call — added header requirement in the healthcheck. Also added rollback policy: auto-roll back if 5xxs > 1% over 5m or p99 latency > 800ms.

Ani P: For package staging to the airlock host we require signed tarball + checksum. Process I suggest:
```
# on build box
tar -czf offsite-v1.2.0.tar.gz ./images
sha256sum offsite-v1.2.0.tar.gz > offsite-v1.2.0.sha256
scp offsite-v1.2.0.* deploy@airlock-host:/opt/staging/
# on airlock host
cd /opt/staging && sha256sum -c offsite-v1.2.0.sha256 && sudo systemctl restart airlock-puller
```
Make sure keys are available in vault. I'll own the staging step and key handoff.

Logan K: Security group example for the customer's VPC (egress):
```
- Allow TCP 443 to 34.82.120.0/22,35.199.64.0/20,52.58.0.0/16
- Allow UDP 123 to pool.ntp.org
- Deny all other internet-bound unless explicitly listed
```
If customer uses a corporate egress proxy, we'll route through it; ping if they do.

Network Team: Also confirm that OCSP/CRL endpoints are reachable (some customers block them). If they're blocked, cert validation will fail on cert rotation.

ops-bot: Reminder: KMS key rotation scheduled tomorrow 07:00 UTC for `projects/customer-a/keys/airlock-key`. Expect short KMS unavailable windows.

Ani P: Noted — I'll delay the staging transfer until after rotation window or hold a manual check.

Devon R: CR comments addressed, added better logging around layer unpack. Tests: local smoke + e2e in staging.

Jen S: Reviewed and merged. Tagged release `offsite-v1.2.0-canary`. Deploy pipeline triggered. :rocket:

Maria G: Canary plan (agreed):
```
canary:
  nodes: 1
  traffic_percent: 10
  duration: 15m
  healthcheck: /hc (X-Offsite-Auth header)
  rollback: on 5xx_rate>1% OR p99>800ms
```
Monitoring: watch errors, latency p50/p95/p99, and auth failures. If green, ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 hours.

Logan K: One more ask — we need IP allowlist for our internal monitoring to pull metrics. I'll send a small CIDR list to the customer's infra contact.

Network Team: We'll also require outbound DNS to resolver ip(s). Confirmed.

Maria G: Owners confirmed: Network = Logan K, Packages = Ani P, Infra = Devon R, Release = Jen S. I'll create checklist in the runbook and schedule a follow-up async update after first canary window. Next quick sync Thu 10:00 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Jen S: If anyone needs me during the canary window ping `#deploy-ops` or @Jen S directly.

Devon R: Leaving a final note: if package verify fails, step should try 3x with exponential backoff before alerting. Added that to PR.

Maria G: Perfect. Closing the loop here — will post post-canary summary in this thread.
